SILENT_EXTENT_LOSS.definition: a check whose failure mode is collecting nothing, read through a channel that cannot distinguish 'ran and passed' from 'did not run'
SILENT_EXTENT_LOSS.instance: test_characterization_protocol.py zero bytes across 3h, 3i, 3j; gate exited 0 three times

pairs_with.why_the_pair_is_the_record: the two are the same failure to declare extent separately from outcome, in opposite directions; neither is visible from the verdict alone

EXTENT_OF_COMPARISON_EXCEEDING_EXTENT_OF.definition: a comparison wider than its subject reports a difference belonging to something else
EXTENT_OF_COMPARISON_EXCEEDING_EXTENT_OF.instance: byte-equality check took four comment lines against a three-line comment, pulling in the NEXT constant's comment and reporting a mismatch that did not exist
EXTENT_OF_COMPARISON_EXCEEDING_EXTENT_OF.symmetry: same day, same node: a comparison WIDER than its subject and a suite NARROWER than its declaration. Common cure is 3l — extent is declared and checked separately from outcome.
